article.title: ‘You can pay off many, you can’t pay off me’: How solidarity brought Ed Sheeran low
article.author: Editor
article.content: The axing of Macklemore from Ed Sheeran’s tour is the latest attempt by pro-Israel pressure to push back on an argument that’s lost, but solidarity wins over fear, argues Dave Randall The post ‘You can pay off many, you can’t pay off me’: How solidarity brought Ed Sheeran low appeared first on MR Online .
